content: Zendesk agent views paginate at 30 tickets per page with explicit pagination controls (generic-table-pagination-first/next, views_views-header-page-amount). Strong indirect evidence that view ticket tables are NOT virtualised: a real DOM table with ~30 rows needs no windowing, and userscripts iterate table.tBodies[0].rows directly and succeed. Garden supports react-window virtual scrolling as an opt-in example only. Treat non-virtualisation as a high-likelihood assumption to validate on a live instance.
